text:
elaine: Quick sync 1: Thinking about a lightweight "circuit" UI for runtime config hits (soft quota/excess calls). Instead of outright blocking routes, show a circuit overlay with options: "throttle", "override (temp)", "route-to-fallback". Prefer minimal clicks.
tom: Love the circuit metaphor. We need clear telemetry keys and a compact API. Suggest naming: config.circuit.opened, config.circuit.action_taken, config.circuit.closed.
jess: From RBAC standpoint, overrides should be scoped. Non-admins can request an override but it becomes pending until an approver clicks approve. Also keep TTL short by default (3m).
elaine: UI wire: small toast + panel listing active circuits per route, who requested, TTL, and quick revoke. Revoke calls DELETE /v1/admin/circuits/{id}.
tom: Implementation: KV store (Redis) for active circuits, replicated to PG for audit. Idempotency for apply key. Instrument histograms for apply latency.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: feature-flag "circuit-ui" enabled for internal orgs at 2024-09-02T17:02:11Z.
elaine: Rollout: internal -> ops teams -> 10% orgs. Add alert if >5 circuits open for same route in 5m.
jess: Security: require scope `circuit.manage`. For hosted customers, require SSO group or explicit org opt-in.
tom: Dashboard: add tiny card in quota dashboard summarizing circuits and recent actions. Also add link to audit log.
elaine: OK I'll draft RFC and mockup. Who wants the API PR?
tom: I'll take API + telemetry.
jess: I'll do RBAC & audit integration.
elaine: Thanks all 44D
